criteria.rule: Exact frozen inputs, canonical structural checks, versions/model and request identity. New point/reusable citations cannot cut inside Latin letter runs; apostrophes and hyphens are allowed boundaries. This is not a morphology parser or cross-cue word inference.
All four cues must occur in selected units; missing targets are not exercised, never silently a pass.
Citation text remains exact reliable source. Explain an affix inside a complete cited word; optional omission is not proof that a feature was exercised.

Each source/example translation preserves the explicit actor, grammatical person/number, recipient and beneficiary. Resolve person only from actual evidence/verb agreement. A plural recipient must not silently create a plural asking actor. A loose team-oriented paraphrase is judged under the same actor-fidelity criterion used in prompts-18.
Check source roles, title/context grounding, contextual chunk meanings, grammar scope, unknown-fragment safety and example situation/action/translation consistency.

acceptance: Generated, structural/source/identity/coverage passed and no blocking or pending editorial finding. Warnings remain explicit.
stoppingRule: No content reruns, alternative selection, fallback, rubric changes or generation-source changes during inference. Preserve all client requests/responses and canonical internal structural repairs. Pre-model credential-lock failures may be retried only with zero model calls and a separate retained record.
limits: Same unblinded Codex reviewer and same-reviewer authored variants, not independent certification or a held-out benchmark.
One output per case; no overall accuracy, stability or causal improvement estimate.
Do not pool earlier-version acceptances with these new outputs.
Traditional/Simplified Chinese reported-role disputes and French unclear-source selection coverage remain outside this set.
No installed Host, personal Chrome/video, audio or learning-effect acceptance.
